acceptance_criteria.statement: Dispute can be raised only for eligible booking states/window.
Active dispute blocks booking closure actions until resolution.
Admin resolution supports customer-favor, tasker-favor, and escalation outcomes with audit trail.
Raise-dispute endpoint is idempotent: same Idempotency-Key replays the original dispute result.
Dispute can only be raised within 24 hours of booking completion; attempts after the window return DISPUTE_WINDOW_EXPIRED.
Admin dispute resolution is idempotent: replaying the resolve request with the same Idempotency-Key binds to the original dispute resource.
